title: Pore-scale simulation on flow and heat transfer characteristics in packed beds with internal heat sources at low Reynolds numbers
material: Li4SiO4 packed bed defining the P418 60-condition matrix
internal_heating: uniform particle volumetric heat source in the numerical model
through_flow: helium through the resolved pore space
measured_quantities: computed pressure; velocity; fluid and solid temperature; interphase heat transfer
numerical_data_available: yes, the 5 velocity x 4 inlet-temperature x 3 heat-source matrix and published correlations are extracted; raw local fields are not public
current_use: defines the present 60-condition operating matrix and same-source correlation comparison
not_used_as: experimental validation or external field training
limitation: This is the numerical source problem, not an experiment; the published average Reynolds definition is incomplete and its Nusselt correlation is not used as a PINN loss.

title: Single-phase convection heat transfer characteristics of pebble-bed channels with internal heat generation
internal_heating: electromagnetic induction heating of the packed spheres
measured_quantities: power distribution; heat-transfer coefficient; inlet-temperature and Reynolds-number trends
numerical_data_available: yes, paper reports experiments and a fitted correlation; raw machine-readable fields are not public
current_use: supports the measurement design for forced convection with internal heating
not_used_as: Li4SiO4-helium material calibration or P418 training label
limitation: The material, fluid and Reynolds-number range differ from P418; the fitted correlation deviates from the reported experiments by up to 12%.

title: Experimental investigation of thermal diffusivity and heat capacity of ceramic breeder beds
material: reference and advanced ceramic breeder beds
fluid: blanket-relevant purge gases in a heated-probe apparatus
measured_quantities: thermal diffusivity; heat capacity; local thermocouple response; phase-transition information
numerical_data_available: yes, aggregate property results are reported; no through-flow temperature field
current_use: checks transient material-property scale and the role of gas type pressure temperature and mechanical state
not_used_as: through-flow convective validation or three-dimensional temperature training
limitation: The probe experiment measures aggregate transient properties rather than a through-flow internally heated bed.

title: Experimental tests on Li-ceramic breeders for the helium cooled pebble bed (HCPB) blanket design
through_flow: cooling and purge arrangements are mock-up specific
measured_quantities: effective thermal conductivity; pebble-wall heat-transfer coefficient; pressure loads; wall deformation
numerical_data_available: yes, apparatus and reported experimental responses are available in the paper; no machine-readable full field
current_use: supports wall heat transfer thermomechanical loading and breeder-mock-up measurement choices
limitation: Mock-up geometry and heater arrangement do not reproduce uniform particle volumetric heating.

title: Thermo-mechanical analysis of pebble beds in HELICA mock-up experiments
fluid: helium coolant plus a separate small helium purge flow
internal_heating: two internal plate heaters; 0-42 kW/m2 in six one-hour steps
through_flow: separate helium cooling channels and purge path; no helium through-flow across the breeder layer
measured_quantities: thermocouple histories at three positions; cassette displacement; coolant conditions
numerical_data_available: yes, experimental curves and stated operating values are public; raw time-series tables are not public
current_use: external transient temperature and wall-cooling comparison at reported sensor positions
not_used_as: direct P418 volumetric-heating or pore-flow training
limitation: Plate heaters create a nonuniform mechanical and thermal disturbance; coolant and purge paths are separate from the P418 pore-flow path.

title: Thermo-mechanical analyses of HELICA and HEXCALIBER mock-ups
material: HELICA Li4SiO4 and HEXCALIBER Li4SiO4-Be layers
fluid: helium used as coolant and purge
internal_heating: two electrical heaters in each pebble layer; 0-42 kW/m2 in six one-hour steps
through_flow: mock-up-specific helium coolant and purge paths
measured_quantities: temperature histories; temperature distribution; cell displacement; stress response
numerical_data_available: yes, selected experimental curves and numerical comparisons are public; no raw machine-readable field
current_use: checks cyclic temperature response and coupling between breeder and multiplier layers
not_used_as: direct P418 field training or validation of uniform volumetric heat generation
limitation: The paper primarily analyses coupled thermo-mechanics and reports sparse sensor histories, not a pore-resolved helium-through-flow field.

title: Simulation of Volumetrically Heated Pebble Beds in Fusion Blankets
fluid: stagnant helium in the breeder bed and water cooling channels
internal_heating: matrix of electrical line heaters within the bed
through_flow: no helium through-flow through the breeder bed
measured_quantities: 70 steady thermocouple values at five power levels; maximum temperature; cooling-channel outlet temperature; heat loss
numerical_data_available: yes, tables and figures have been digitized in this project
current_use: quantitative internal-heating temperature comparison and leave-one-power low-rank correction demonstration
limitation: The heater matrix is not neutron volumetric heating and the breeder-bed helium is stagnant.

title: Macroscopic transport characteristics in packed bed with a multi-physics inversion strategy for solid breeding blanket of HCCB TBM
material: Chinese HCCB TBM Li4SiO4 packed-bed pore-scale and packed-bed models
internal_heating: uniform particle heat source in the numerical models
through_flow: helium through the pore-scale and porous-medium domains
measured_quantities: computed pressure drop; temperature distribution; concentration distribution; inverted effective transport parameters
numerical_data_available: yes, geometry properties equations and reported comparison values are extracted; no experimental field
current_use: supplies the reconstructed HCCB geometry material properties boundary conditions and macroscopic-correlation comparison
not_used_as: experimental validation or proof of measured full-field accuracy
limitation: Both fine and reduced results are generated numerically; the reported modified-correlation errors are same-study comparisons.
